skill_name: Create a persuasive argument on why schools should offer more computer science classes.
workflow: It is clear that computer science classes should be made available in more schools. This is due to the digital nature of the world we live in. In recent years, technology has advanced to such an extent that almost every industry relies heavily on digital tools and digital platforms. Those who are not familiar with the basics of how computers and digital technology work are at a great disadvantage because they will lack the skills that can help make them successful in the workplace.
